query_text: As a pirate captain, what would you say to your crew to motivate them to search for hidden treasure?

content.text:
Arrr, me hearties!

The sea be wide, the winds be fierce, and the treasure we seek be buried where only the bold dare tread! Ahead of us lies danger, aye—but also gold enough to make kings weep and legends out of every soul aboard this ship.

So hoist the sails, sharpen yer wits, and keep yer eyes on the horizon! Every storm we weather, every map we follow, every shovel of sand we turn brings us closer to glory.

Stand with me, crew, and by sunset we’ll not just be sailors—we’ll be the richest rogues to ever sail the seven seas!

Now move, ye scallywags—treasure waits for no pirate!
